name: find_customer
description: Look up the caller in EasyLink by phone (preferred) or email. Call at the start of every call. Returns their first name, area, sales stage and project phase, or found=false.

name: save_enquiry
description: Create or update the caller's enquiry with what they told you: name, contact, address, interests (solar, battery, EV charger, heat pump), quarterly bill, roof, timing, budget, notes. Returns leadId.

address.description: Full street address including suburb, state and postcode

quarterlyBill.description: Electricity bill per quarter in AUD

name: site_visit_times
description: Get free site-visit times (weekdays, Sydney time). Offer two or three of the returned times.

fromDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, earliest day the caller wants

days.description: How many days ahead to look, up to 10

name: book_site_visit
description: Book a one-hour site visit at one of the times from site_visit_times. Needs the leadId from find_customer or save_enquiry.

notes.description: Access, pets, parking or anything the visitor should know

name: indicative_price
description: Indicative price range for a solar system, with or without a battery, after the federal STC discount. Never quote it as a final price.

systemKw.description: Solar size in kW, e.g. 6.6 or 10

phase.description: Single or three phase power, if known

name: job_status
description: Where an existing customer's job is up to, and their next booking.

name: request_callback
description: Book a call back from a team member, e.g. out of hours, a pricing question beyond your limits, or when asked for a person who is unavailable.

preferredTime.description: ISO date-time in Sydney time, if the caller gave one

name: report_service_issue
description: Log a warranty or service problem and book an urgent or normal call back. Set safetyIssue for smoke, burning smell, sparking or water in equipment.

name: add_call_note
description: Add a short note to the customer's record, e.g. commitments made or questions to follow up.
